# UI scenes captured for visual review in CI and uploaded to Argos. Generated by packages/client-ui/scripts/scene-listing.mjs; do not edit.
# Run `pnpm --filter @agent-wechat/client-ui scenes:list` after changing them. A screenshot is named `<scene>@<viewport>`; viewports are
# `desktop` (1280x800), `narrow` (390x844), `compact` (320x700), joined by `+` for multiple sizes.
# Format: ITEM | ATTRIBUTES | DESCRIPTION
scene account-list | route /{server}/accounts, viewports desktop+narrow | The accounts on a hub: one signed in and one that still needs a QR code.
scene chat-filters | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop+compact | The conversation filter bar with All pinned beside the scrolling categories and unread badges for categories with new messages.
scene chat-info | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/info, viewports desktop+narrow | Details of a group conversation with its pin, mute and group settings.
scene chat-list | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop+narrow | The full inbox with category and conversation unread counts and the newest conversation open beside it.
scene contacts | route /{server}/{account}/contacts, viewports desktop | The contact list of an account.
scene direct-chat | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop+narrow | A direct conversation with text from both sides and a photo.
scene group-chat | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop | A group conversation where each message names its sender, ending in a photo.
scene hub-picker | route /servers, viewports desktop+narrow | The screen for choosing which hub to connect to.
scene login-qr | route /{server}/{account}/login, viewports desktop+narrow | Sign-in screen of an account that is not signed in, showing the QR code to scan.
scene media-viewer | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/media/{message}, viewports desktop+narrow | The photo viewer open over a conversation, on the photo Mei sent.
scene message-highlight | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}/message/{message}, viewports desktop | A conversation opened at one message, which is highlighted.
scene mini-program-cards | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop+narrow | Mini Program cards with an available shared page and a missing package.
scene mini-program-list | route /{server}/{account}/mini-programs, viewports desktop+narrow | Programs from the account cache and cards, with metadata icons independent of chat media.
scene new-chat | route /{server}/{account}/new-chat, viewports desktop | The dialog for starting a direct conversation from the contact list.
scene new-group | route /{server}/{account}/new-chat, viewports desktop | The new chat dialog on its New group tab, with two contacts chosen.
scene new-group-avatar | route /{server}/{account}/chats, viewports desktop | A newly received group shows its room avatar while its member list is unavailable.
scene quoted-sender-names | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop+narrow | Quoted replies use supplied author names, cached names for older replies, and You for own messages.
scene settings | route /{server}/{account}/settings, viewports desktop+narrow | Settings for the app, the hub and the signed-in account.
scene unnamed-group-chat | route /{server}/{account}/chats/{thread}, viewports desktop+narrow | An unnamed group labeled with member names in the chat list and conversation header.
